parsed.note_claim: The document is fabricated and not issued by India's Ministry of Defence.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Pakistan's claim that its hypersonic missiles fired from JF-17 fighter jets destroyed India's S-400 air defence system in Adampur is "false", an Indian military official said
parsed.reason: The article confirms Indian military officials denied the S-400 destruction claims, substantiating the note's assertion that the document is fabricated.
